input.command:
cd /home/agent/repos/jsonschema && BIN=build/src/jsonschema; TMP=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$TMP/schema.json" <<'EOF'
{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "$id": "https://example.com", "$ref": "nested" }
EOF
echo "===== bundle --without-id stderr ====="; "$BIN" bundle "$TMP/schema.json" --without-id 2>&1 >/dev/null || true
# resolver warning: resolve a schema file with no identifiers at all
mkdir "$TMP/emptyres"
cat > "$TMP/emptyres/no-id.json" <<'EOF'
{ "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema", "type": "string" }
EOF
cat > "$TMP/inst.json" <<'EOF'
"x"
EOF
echo "===== validate --resolve no-id (likely warning) ====="; "$BIN" validate "$TMP/schema.json" "$TMP/inst.json" --resolve "$TMP/emptyres" 2>&1 >/dev/null || true
rm -rf "$TMP"
